SELECT 
    user_id, 
    username, 
    password, 
    fullname, 
    role, 
    is_active 
FROM dbo.users 
WHERE username = '{{ $json.body.username.replace(/'/g, "''") }}';

SELECT 
    u.user_id, 
    u.username, 
    u.fullname, 
    u.role, 
    u.is_active, 
    u.last_login,
    ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.chat_sessions WHERE user_id = u.user_id), 0) AS total_sessions
FROM dbo.users u
ORDER BY u.user_id ASC;

DELETE FROM dbo.chat_sessions 
WHERE user_id = {{ $('Validate Delete').first().json.target_user_id }};
